label: PLACE19 Māori GIS conference opens in Rotorua
summary: Te Kāhui Manu Hōkai convened the PLACE19 conference in Rotorua, with over 100 delegates and sessions on people, landscapes, assets, communication and education.

sources.label: Te Kāhui Manu Hōkai, the Māori GIS Association, 13–15 November 2019; supplied primary-source copy catalogued with SHA-256
